name: Widescreen
description: Battles and the field fill a widescreen (16:9, 16:10): more of the arena and of the map shows at both sides, the menus and the HUD stay as drawn in the middle. Needs the GPU renderer (Video); with the software renderer the picture stays 4:3. The menus and the movies stay 4:3. A new window opens 16:9.

options.name: The field
options.description: The field map widens too. Maps narrower than the screen show black at the sides. Off: only battles widen.
